ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity blobs occupy the distal two-thirds of both left and right lobes; a low-intensity black central region extends from the peduncle into the medial fluke area with high-frequency stippling at the boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical notch; estimated angle of 40 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular scalloped pattern across the entire trailing edge; visible peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes from 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve characterized by concavity near the median notch transitioning to a strong convexity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular clusters at the distal tips (consistent with barnacle colonization); scattered small circular white punctate marks within the central dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white high-intensity patches on the right lobe and lower left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Protruding calcified clusters on the extreme lateral tips; irregular notches and potential trauma marks along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
